name: Hatefury Claw
summary: A Hatefury Claw is taken from the satyrs east of Nijel’s Point in Desolace. Kreldig Ungor gathers claws and horns for a gnome mage in Kharanos.

sections.title: A Reclaimer’s List
sections.body: Kreldig Ungor has come to Desolace with a list of reagents from Leftwitch, a gnome mage in Kharanos. The Hatefury satyrs among Sargeron’s ruins, east of Nijel’s Point, carry the claws and horns he needs. Bring the gathered materials to Kreldig, and he will set about the next item on the list.

faq.answer: Kreldig Ungor gathers Hatefury Claws and horns for Leftwitch, a gnome mage in Kharanos.

faq.q: Where do Hatefury Claws come from?
faq.answer: Hatefury satyrs in the Sargeron ruins, east of Nijel’s Point in Desolace, carry the claws.
Kreldig is gathering reagents from a list sent by Leftwitch, a gnome mage in Kharanos.
Kreldig needs Hatefury Horns as well as Hatefury Claws for Leftwitch’s list.

angles.text: As a gnome, Leftwitch’s request reaches you through Kreldig Ungor, who gathers reagents in Desolace for the mage in Kharanos.
As a mage, you may recognize the practical need behind Leftwitch’s list: Kreldig is gathering claws and horns as reagents.
